headline: Up Your Arsenal adds 29 front-end functions in C
summary: Up Your Arsenal gained 26 shared PAL/NTSC-U front-end implementations and three NTSC-U-only implementations in C (#2). A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The recorded PAL v1.00 progress remains at 8.72% of code matched, with 5,810 of 16,164 functions matching. Build tooling also fixes native C exclusion from the PAL object fallback.
highlights: Four other function reconstructions remain unfinished (#2).
